message.content: This illustration is the cover of a magazine. It features an orange-colored masthead reading "TEMPO" across the top. Above it is smaller white text: "INVESTIGASI: SWASEMBADA GULA CARA AMRAN DAN ISAM". Below the masthead is the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Centered is a person’s head and neck, mostly obscured by numerous pale, reddish-brown hands. One hand pulls up a section of blue medical mask, exposing one wide, blue eye. Other hands grip the head, neck, and shoulders. The person wears a blue surgical mask covering the mouth and nose. On the lower right chest, a badge displays a golden bird emblem and the letters "KPK". On the center-left, large white text reads: "OBITUARI: KOMISI PEMBERANTASAN KORUPSI". In the bottom left corner, there is a date, "9-15 SEPTEMBER 2019", price information, a website URL, and a barcode. The background is a dark, solid color, creating a stark contrast with the brightly lit hands and the central face. All characters and objects are rendered in a painterly style.
